sn20.2:1.2: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi
sn20.2:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yo cāyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito yā cāyaṃ mahāpaṭhavīti.
sn20.2:1.6: appamattakoyaṃ bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āro pito
sn20.2:1.7: saṅkhampi na upeti upanidhampi na upeti kalabhāgampi na upeti mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropitoti.
sn20.2:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti
sn20.2:1.9: atha kho eteyeva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.
